# Homepage visuals

Generated for the Zhenxing Train homepage on 2026-09-29.

- `high-speed-hero-v2.jpg`: Creative studio scene combining Harmony, Fuxing, Shinkansen, ICE and TGV model trains.
- `layout-studio-v2.jpg`: Creative miniature railway layout scene.

These are homepage campaign illustrations, not official product photographs or screenshots of the track editor. The catalogue and the three featured product cards continue using manufacturer product images.

PNG originals are retained in the local Codex generation output. Website assets use JPEG encoding for faster loading. The page preserves the image proportions and respects reduced-motion preferences.
